verdict.rationale: Godot's editor is built around a Node/Scene composition system (scenes act as reusable prefabs), an Inspector for editing node/resource properties, and a viewport for 2D/3D level layout, all documented as core editor features; community testimonials corroborate daily use of the visual editor alongside scripting. missing for 10: no direct hands-on citation of the Inspector UI or viewport gizmos specifically for level-building workflows, and no independent technical-artist testimonial focused on non-programmer usability.
